sections.Profile:
"Spot-Pool" is a billiards-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on February 10, 1959. Designed by Harry Williams, the game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, and five standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme, Single level playfield
